svg.text: The installer and its init file travel together; clients in a subnet form a chain, and only the chain ends talk to the server on TCP 17472.

svg.text: Without the init file the installer still finishes "successfully" and the service runs, but the client has no server

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to register with: installed but invisible. Never reuse an init file from another environment.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Methods: A manual · B silent CLI or PowerShell (/S) · C remote (PsExec, WinRM) · D Intune Win32, ConfigMgr, GPO startup script · E Tanium client deployment

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Registration needs the right init file, an open path on TCP 17472, and a correct clock. Host firewalls allow 17472 inbound from the local subnet for peering.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
